Nina (Head of Reliability): quick post-all-hands thread to capture the RCA link and owners for the incident follow-up. RCA (internal): https://redwood.internal/rcas/2026-05-05/serve-latency-spike

Sam (SRE): saw the doc. plan in RCA: canary 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 30m windows, rollback on sustained p95 delta > 25%. i'll own rollout and runbook.

Priya (Product): product request: one-line Console timeline + short FAQ. Omar, want to co-author support copy?

Omar (Support): yes. need affected org export and the impact window from the RCA to draft outreach.

Raj (CTO): leadership note: we'll prioritize route & KV observability in Optimize backlog. funding approved for dashboards + alerting.

Nina (Head of Reliability): action table in RCA: Sam (rollout & runbook), Priya (console blurb), Omar (support comms), Platform (dashboards). please confirm by EOD so i can mark in-progress.

Sam (SRE): confirmed. posting runbook snippet to eng-sre repo shortly.

Priya (Product): confirmed. drafting console copy now.

Omar (Support): confirmed. awaiting org export.

inc-bot: checklist created in RCA and assigned to owners.

Nina (Head of Reliability): scheduling a 30m blameless review next week; invite will include timeline, logs, and RCA. flag blockers here.

Sam (SRE): none from me.

Priya (Product): all good.

Omar (Support): will flag if export delayed.

Nina (Head of Reliability): thanks team — RCA remains single source of truth for follow-ups.
